resources.string: CoGra is invite-only: someone who knows you vouches you in. Paste your invite link (or its code) below.
That doesn\'t contain an invite code.
This invite doesn\'t exist. Check the link with the person who sent it.
This invite can\'t be used any more — it expired, was revoked, or its slot is taken. Ask your inviter for a new one.
That email already belongs to an account — sign in instead.
Your identity on the graph is a key that exists only on this phone. A recovery code lets you restore it if this phone is ever lost — we store only an encrypted copy that the code unlocks.
Write this code down somewhere safe — on paper is best. It is shown only this once, and we can never recover it for you.

If this phone is lost or broken, your posts, relationships, and standing are permanently lost with it. Your login would survive, but the actor behind it can never be restored. You can create a backup later in Settings.
Can\'t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
This phone\'s signing key already belongs to another account. Sign in to that account to use it — a key can only ever back one account.
Passwords need at least 12 characters and can\'t be a known breached password.
Too many attempts — wait a moment and try again.
